meta.title: Housing affordability and homelessness, 16 days of posts
meta.subject: housing affordability in Texas — rents and home prices, manufactured and factory-built housing, tiny homes, lot-size and zoning rules, county and city development regulations, NIMBY opposition to new communities, and homelessness policy including encampment bans and housing-first funding
meta.subtitle: Oct 1 to Oct 16, 2026. Each dot is one post with 1K+ views about Texas housing affordability, manufactured housing and homelessness, plus every post repeating an earlier one, in the lane for what it argues. Higher and bigger means more views. White means 90% or more the same words as an earlier post, with a white line back to it. Coloured lines link a post to the post it quoted or replied to. Updated daily.

lanes.label: Cut rules, build more supply
lanes.description: Texas rents and prices are high because zoning, minimum lot sizes, permitting and parking rules block construction, so cities and counties should deregulate and let more homes be built.

lanes.label: Manufactured and tiny homes fix it
lanes.description: Manufactured, modular, factory-built and tiny homes are the fast, cheap route to affordable Texas housing, and rules that restrict them should be loosened.

lanes.label: Blame investors, landlords, developers
lanes.description: Corporate landlords, institutional investors, out-of-state buyers and big developers are driving up Texas rents and home prices and pricing out residents.

lanes.label: Protect neighborhoods, local control
lanes.description: Residents oppose new apartments, subdivisions and manufactured-home communities as threats to neighborhood character, traffic, schools and property values, and defend local and county control over development.

lanes.label: Enforce encampment bans, restore order
lanes.description: Homelessness is a public-safety and disorder problem, so Texas should enforce camping bans, clear encampments and push people into shelter or treatment.

lanes.label: Fund housing-first, not criminalization
lanes.description: Ending homelessness requires funding permanent supportive housing and services, and encampment bans and arrests only move people around without fixing the cause.

lanes.label: Pushback
lanes.description: Posts doubting, mocking, fact-checking or arguing against the dominant framings.
